name: JetBrains Marketplace plugins
auth: The tested native IDE uses a repository with explicit anonymous READ authorization. It does not send AW_TOKEN. Anonymous access must be enabled and permission granted by an administrator; the endpoint still returns 401 before that grant.
fresh_home: Set IDEA_PROPERTIES to a newly created properties file whose config, system, plugins and log paths are distinct empty directories under AW_WORK.
prerequisites: Remote jetbrainsplugins repository with a compatible Marketplace upstream.
AW_PLUGIN_ID is the plugin XML ID of an upstream plugin compatible with IDEA 2025.3. The controlled fixture uses com.weave.fixture; it is not a public plugin.

configure.code:
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
export IDEA_PROPERTIES="$AW_WORK/idea.properties"
cat > "$IDEA_PROPERTIES" <<EOF
idea.plugins.host=$AW_URL/artifactory/api/jetbrainsplugins/$AW_REPO
idea.config.path=$AW_WORK/config
idea.system.path=$AW_WORK/system
idea.plugins.path=$AW_WORK/plugins
idea.log.path=$AW_WORK/log
EOF

publish.note: Remote-only repository; publishing a plugin to the upstream Marketplace is outside this service.

install.note: The real IDE resolves compatibility and installs the archive.

limitations: Only the remote class is supported.
Keep the custom Marketplace host separate from the ordinary IDE user profile.
REST authentication support does not imply the native IDE can supply repository tokens.
